profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with extensive experience in leading global deployment orchestration services and developing predictive analytic models for Azure Storage. Proven track record in enhancing security initiatives, creating custom deployment solutions, and developing next-generation orchestration systems. Awarded Azure Core Champion for outstanding contributions to security practices. Skilled in various programming languages and frameworks, with a strong background in electrical engineering and cloud services. Committed to driving innovation and efficiency in software development and deployment processes.
